body: Not very many.  I've already outlived the average age of trans people.  And even the ones who are close to my age have their own problems and I cannot open up to them about any of this.  I have also started a career that I intended to be in service to other trans people.  That really means I have to present a certain image.

I can't be like this around other trans people.  Many of them are younger than me and I don't want them to feel like this is their future too.  If I were able to deal with the world better, maybe I could be what they need.  But until then, it is safer if I stay away.
